column1: Basic Practices
Clear accountability

The senior management of an organisation should provide clear direction on ICT security goals and policies for personal data protection within the organisation. The involvement and support of an organisation's leadership is important in demonstrating commitment to ICT security for data protection.

Data protection risks may be managed through ICT controls. Close collaboration is necessary between data protection and ICT security functions within an organisation. This should be evidenced at appropriate levels of its governance structure.
Standards, policies and procedures

AnorganisationisrequiredtodevelopandimplementICTsecurity policies for data protection. Key ICT policies would include: • Account and access control policy • Backup/retention policy • Password policy The policies will help to provide management with the direction as well as guidance for all ICT system implementations and activities related to data protection in ICT systems in accordance with business objectives and relevant laws and regulations.
